# WebCatalog

> WebCatalog transforms websites into native desktop applications with multi-account management, productivity tools, and browser extensions for Mac and Windows.

WebCatalog offers a suite of products including Desktop (web-to-app converter), Atlas (speed dial extension), Singlebox (unified messenger), and Switchbar (browser picker), plus pre-built desktop apps for popular services like ChatGPT, Gmail, Google Drive, and social platforms.

## Key Topics

- WebCatalog Desktop
- Multi-account Management
- Desktop Apps
- Mac & Windows
- WebCatalog Atlas
- Browser Extension
- Singlebox Messenger
- Switchbar
- AI Chatbots
- Productivity Tools
- Cloud Sync
- App Launcher
- Cross-Platform
- Privacy Protection
- Web App Integration

## Core Products

- [WebCatalog Desktop for Mac, Windows](https://webcatalog.io/en/desktop): Turn websites into desktop apps, manage multiple accounts and organize workflows
- [WebCatalog Atlas - Speed Dial - Simple & tidy new tab page](https://webcatalog.io/en/atlas): Browser extension: Organize web apps with speed dial, folders, cloud sync across devices
- [Singlebox Messenger - All-in-One Messenger for Mac & PC](https://webcatalog.io/en/singlebox): All-in-one messenger combining chats, emails, and web apps in single window
- [Switchbar - Browser picker for macOS & Windows](https://webcatalog.io/en/switchbar): Browser picker managing multiple browsers and profiles

## AI & Productivity Apps

- [WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/chatgpt): ChatGPT desktop app: AI assistant with voice chat, analysis, and multi-account management
- [Google Gemini - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-bard): Google Gemini desktop app: AI chatbot with image generation and Gmail integration
- [WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/grok): Grok desktop app: AI assistant with image generation and real-time information
- [Google Calendar - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-calendar): Schedule events with multi-account management
- [Google Drive - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-drive): Cloud storage with file sync and collaboration

## Communication & Messaging Apps

- [Gmail - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/gmail): Email client with multi-account and distraction-free window
- [WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/whatsapp): WhatsApp desktop app: Messaging and VoIP with multi-account support
- [Google Voice - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/google-voice): VoIP service with call and voicemail management

## Social Media & Entertainment Apps

- [YouTube - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/youtube): Watch videos in dedicated window with multi-account support
- [X - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/twitter): X (Twitter) desktop app: Social media with multi-account and distraction-free support
- [Instagram - Desktop App for Mac, Windows (PC) - WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/instagram): Social media platform with multi-account support
- [WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/facebook): Facebook desktop app: Social networking with multi-account support
- [WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/tiktok): TikTok desktop app: Short-form video platform with multi-account support

## Shopping & Commerce Apps

- [WebCatalog](https://webcatalog.io/en/apps/amazon): Amazon Shopping desktop app: E-commerce with AR and multi-account management
